method: Always, sometimes or never: a number ending in 5 is a multiple of 5.
Find a counterexample: 'all multiples of 3 are odd'.
Always, sometimes or never: even + odd is odd.
Test 'the sum of two consecutive numbers is always odd' with 4 examples. Is it always true?
Explain why in the portal response box: 'Two consecutive numbers are one odd and one even, so ...'
Is the product of three consecutive numbers always a multiple of 6? Explain.

questions.q: Test 'the sum of two consecutive numbers is always odd' with 4 examples. Is it always true?
Explain why in the portal response box: 'Two consecutive numbers are one odd and one even, so ...'
questions.a: One is even and one odd, and even + odd is always odd (n + n + 1 = 2n + 1)
